WWCR 2 Nashville, TN FAQ

What frequency is WWCR 2 Nashville, TN on?
In the A-26 season WWCR 2 Nashville, TN is scheduled on 3 shortwave frequencies, including 5935, 7490, 9350 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9350 kHz (4 pm – 8 pm Eastern). For Europe: 9350 kHz (9 pm – 1 am UTC+1).

Can I hear WWCR 2 Nashville, TN in the USA?
Yes. WWCR 2 Nashville, TN is beamed at North America this season on 5935, 7490, 9350 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 9350 kHz (4 pm – 8 pm Eastern).

Does WWCR 2 Nashville, TN broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 5935 kHz at 00:00–12:00 UTC to North America; 5935 kHz at 23:00–13:00 UTC to North America; 7490 kHz at 12:00–15:00 UTC to North America; 9350 kHz at 20:00–24h UTC to North America; 9350 kHz at 21:00–23:00 UTC to North America.
